text: Every finding MUST come from the script output and MUST name an element copied from the input with its line; NEVER report an element that is not in the input.
checklist: Each finding's element is found in the input and comes from the script output.

text: Every finding MUST give the rule id, the success criterion number, its name and level (A or AA) of WCAG 2.2, who is affected and the fix as a code change.
checklist: Each finding shows rule id, SC number, name, level, who is affected and a diff fix.

text: The criterion number, name, level and status MUST be the ones the script prints; NEVER change or invent them.
checklist: Every SC number, level and status in the reply appears in the script output.

text: A fix MUST be a small code change on the element in diff form; NEVER change a visible word, and fill every placeholder from the input.
checklist: Each fix is a diff of one element; no visible word of the input changed; placeholders are filled or asked.

text: A fix MUST use a native HTML element where one does the job; NEVER add ARIA that native HTML already provides.
checklist: No fix adds a role or aria attribute where a native element does the job.

text: NEVER report or fix contrast ratios, focus-ring style, spacing or target size; when asked, say the fixed sentence.
checklist: No finding or fix is about contrast, focus-ring style, spacing or target size; a request for them got the exact sentence.

text: NEVER judge the flow or usability; when asked, say the fixed sentence.
checklist: No finding judges the flow or usability; a request for it got the exact sentence.

text: NEVER rewrite visible text; when asked, say the fixed sentence.
checklist: No visible word is rewritten; a request to rewrite got the exact sentence.

text: NEVER claim or imply full conformance or give a certificate; say the fixed sentence and list the checks that ran and those that need a manual test.
checklist: The reply never says compliant, conformant, certified or accessible about the input and lists the manual tests.

text: With no code, the skill MUST ask for it with the exact sentence and NEVER produce findings.
checklist: With no code, the reply is the exact sentence and contains no finding or heading.

text: The reply MUST follow the format of layer 08: Findings, Needs a manual test, Not checked here, Open questions.
checklist: The reply has the four section headings in order.

text: The script MUST be run on the input; when it cannot run, the reply MUST say so in Open questions and use only the checks of the references, by reading.
checklist: The reply used the script output, or said in Open questions that the script did not run.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.
